docAnalysis.title: Document Analysis
docAnalysis.heading: Tender Document Compliance Analysis
docAnalysis.subtitle: Upload an official Notice Inviting Tender (NIT), schedule of requirements, or technical clause document to automatically extract engineering specifications and match them with Indian Standards (IS).
docAnalysis.dragDrop: Drag and drop your tender file here
docAnalysis.fileSizeNote: PDF, DOCX, or TXT format up to 15 MB
docAnalysis.noExplicitSpecs: Semantic clauses matched applicable standards without explicit numerical unit parameters.
docAnalysis.cap1Desc: Parses unstructured tender text for technical parameters: wattage, IP ingress ratings, nominal bore, voltage, and tensile yield strength.
docAnalysis.cap2Desc: Evaluates specifications against 218+ Indian Standards (IS codes) using semantic embeddings and multi-attribute keyword overlap.
docAnalysis.cap3Desc: Checks products against Government of India Quality Control Orders to determine whether ISI marking is legally compulsory for procurement.
docAnalysis.cap4Desc: Outputs an evidence-backed compliance matrix with verifiable clause excerpts suitable for tender evaluation and GeM procurement audits.

qco.title: QCO Checker
qco.heading: Quality Control Order Checker
qco.subtitle: Check whether a product falls under a mandatory Quality Control Order (QCO) issued by the Government of India requiring compulsory BIS ISI marking.
qco.placeholder: Enter product name (e.g., LED Street Light, Pressure Cooker, TMT Steel Bar)...
qco.mandatoryCovered: This product is covered under a statutory Quality Control Order (QCO). Mandatory ISI marking is compulsory prior to sale, distribution, or import.
qco.voluntaryCovered: This product is governed under voluntary BIS Product Certification / standard conformity assessment procedures.
qco.noMatchDesc: Try a different product name or use the Search Standards screen for semantic clause matching.
qco.disclaimer: Quality Control Order status is synchronized with official DPIIT and BIS Gazette Notifications. Always cross-verify with official statutory notifications for legal procurement mandates.
